contracts: active row cache invalidation after write
security_boundaries: system/global writes use explicit global-admin transaction
tenant_boundaries: active/version/list visibility scoped to org plus legacy NULL

findings.evidence: Legacy save/archive/insert and activate/archive/enable sequences were not atomic; save allocated the next version before the transaction.
findings.impact: Concurrent saves could allocate the same org-scoped version and mid-write failure could leave zero or multiple active policies.
findings.fix: Injected optional RequestDatabaseContext, moved version allocation/decision/archive/insert into one policy write transaction, wrapped legacy activation, and invalidated cache only after commit.

findings.evidence: Active policy cache is per service instance with 30s TTL and explicit invalidation.
findings.impact: A direct DB write outside policy services could serve stale policy for up to TTL.
findings.fix: Keep all policy mutations through service/governed paths; document TTL as a deployment constraint.

findings.evidence: savePolicy test did not prove production request transaction usage.
findings.impact: Atomic version allocation could regress silently.
findings.fix: Constructed service with RequestDatabaseContext test double and asserted savePolicy enters runInTransaction.
